verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any way to issue scoped or least-privilege API credentials for an agent. The only auth-related item says Gemini CLI avoids API key management by using Google account sign-in, which is a different capability. The 'Enterprise features: Advanced security and compliance' line is too generic to count as credential scoping.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
